facts.text: Serve the meatball subs when Johnny brings back lunch for Pappas.
facts.why: On the stakeout Pappas says the sandwich shop round the corner sells the best meatball sandwiches and sends Utah to get two, so Johnny does bring back lunch for Pappas.
Same scene: Utah orders the two meatball sandwiches for the stakeout.
